Cheren: I believe it would be wise for me
to catch some Ground-type Pokémon.{VAR BE01}
Or perhaps I should strengthen my
Pokémon. What's my best path forward?

Cheren: Nimbasa City's gate is
straight down Route 4.{VAR BE01}

When I look at the freeway,
I feel exhilarated!

Ruins buried in the desert...
It's like a grand adventure in a story.

entries.text:
Tired Workers should head
to the prefab house by Castelia City!
